scope: every note-bearing data source under frontend/public/data that a page can read: syllabus-notes manifests, unclaimed note files, the supplementary ravikishan manifest, and the remaining note payloads loaded by path

legend.authored: most of the payload is topic-specific content
legend.template: most of the payload is generator stock ("Core point for X.", "X covers essential principles and applications.")

orphans.note: note files no _manifest.json claims — shipped bytes no page loads

supplementary.note: second content family; entries carry their payload inline (readers use data, not the path)
